description: This file defines the class DefaultGatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig, which implements the GatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig interface. It provides configuration handling for timeout durations, caching enabling, and cache configuration within a gateway signal enrichment context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultGatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing configuration for signal enrichment, managing timeout, caching, and cache configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate DefaultGatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured ask timeout Duration.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the CacheConfig object associated with this configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Produces a Config object representing the current configuration state for serialization or inspection.
